name: book-reader
description: Read a docs board as letter sheets. Embed anywhere, or variant=page for a full-page reader. pages=auto|1|2 (mobile always 1). board is required.

board.description: Docs board slug (folder under content/docs). Required. Query ?board= overrides the prop.

variant.description: embed (default, fills the host) or page (full viewport, hides site chrome).

pages.description: auto (default: two on wide, one on mobile), 1, or 2. Narrow hosts always show 1.

backdrop.description: Reader ground: a CSS color, or 'transparent'. Embed defaults to transparent; page defaults to #141c1a.
